shift.proof: After BUILD i=0..3, shift register contains {b0,b1,b2,b3}, equal to original descending128-bit indexed writes. SHA256 only accepts in SEND; reset causes next job to overwrite all four beats.
shift.tradeoff: More FF transitions during BUILD; power not measured.

recipe.proof: Mux of256-bit sources followed byword extraction is replaced with mux of each source word. Literal and pad XOR cases retain their exact64-bit values and index semantics.

compressor.proof: P1 initialCV/tag remain constant throughout recirculation. Capture on input handshake produces the same value seen by the separate output feed-forward edge, including acceptance coincident with previous completion. P>1 transfers retain original update predicate.

control.proof: Register-only controls execute and retire on one edge; storage/I/O completion pulses remain registered. Prior pulse is consumed before next token is loaded.
control.unmeasured_cycle_saving: one cycle per legal register-only control instruction
control.diagnostic_caveat: Illegal arithmetic at PC127 can change debug error_code priority when executor parameter fault and sequencer PC-overflow coincide. Functional error/abort preserved. Not selected unless independently justified.

comparison_scope: This experiment optimizes c implementation, not a uniform i/c/t backend replacement. Attribute any comparison gain to both implementation changes and control architecture until applicable backend changes are propagated and remeasured.
